styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small grey lead-weight block with a ring handle on top. It has about 5 lightness steps on the body: a highlight edge, light, mid, dark and a deep shadow side. The outline leans blue-grey, matching the metal beside it, rather than being a neutral black line. The facts agree: 0% of dark edge pixels are neutral, against 100% for the lamp reference. Its 17 distinct colours per tile match the cheese stall (17) and are close to the roofed well (20), and it is above the hedge (10). Flat-fill coverage is 0%. Its 19 distinct colours in total are reasonable for a piece this small. The surface carries some highlight and shadow variation, though it is less textured than the roofed well or cheese stall. Placed next to the references, it would not look thinner, flatter or more sticker-like.
